d:
Samandar pirhiyon se inke lie kam ki jagah aur aajivika ka zariya raha hai. lekin samandar ke barhte tapman aur yahan ke halat men ho rahe badlav, us pani ka rup bhi badal rahe hain jise ye mahilaen bahut karib se janti hain.
Hamari mulakat aisi mahilaon se huee jo samudri shaival yani sivid ikattha karti hain. in mahilaon ne samandar men aae badlavon ko apni aankhon se dekha hai. pani ke niche ugne vali chizon men aae badlavon se lekar apni aajivika par parne vale asar tak.
